_note: Hand-written plans for the invented host_wren property, used when no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set (or --plan is not passed). Each passes planner.check against its reading (house plan: the all-rooms reading; pillows: that room's reading).

store.name: Wren House Line
store.tagline: One quiet look across every room
store.about: A proposed line for this property: if the host orders it, the rug and print carry the colours its rooms share, and each room gets a pillow in its own accent.

products.title: House Field Rug
products.prompt: A printed flat rug, 5 x 8 ft: a wide oat-linen field with a walnut border band, one offset olive block in a corner and a thin brass line inside the border, calm geometry, low pile look, no text, no logos.
products.why: Warm wood and linen show up in 67% of the property's moments, so the rug is built on them.

products.title: Brass and Olive
products.prompt: An abstract wall print: two overlapping soft-edged circles, one brass and one olive, on an oat-linen ground with a single walnut horizon line, matte flat colour, no text.
products.why: Brass fittings appear in 42% of the property's moments.

store.name: Bedroom pillow
store.about: Proposed for the bedroom: the pillow echoes the rust already on the bed, set on the house linen.

products.title: Rust Stripe Pillow
products.prompt: A 20 x 20 in throw pillow cover: three wide rust stripes on an oat-linen ground with a thin walnut pinstripe between them, pattern kept 3 cm clear of the seams, no text.
products.why: Rust bedding shows up in 50% of this room's moments; the pillow echoes that rust.

store.name: Living room pillow
store.about: Proposed for the living room: the pillow echoes the teal sofa, with olive from the rest of the house.

products.title: Teal Block Pillow
products.prompt: A 20 x 20 in throw pillow cover: a large teal square offset to one corner on an oat-linen ground, a narrow olive band along one edge, pattern kept 3 cm clear of the seams, no text.
products.why: A teal velvet sofa shows up in 75% of this room's moments; the pillow echoes that teal.

store.name: Loft pillow
store.about: Proposed for the loft: the pillow echoes the mustard armchair, grounded in charcoal.

products.title: Mustard Arc Pillow
products.prompt: A 20 x 20 in throw pillow cover: a single wide mustard arc on a charcoal ground with an oat-linen dot, the arc ending 3 cm before the seams, no text.
products.why: The mustard armchair shows up in 50% of this room's moments; the pillow echoes that mustard.
